title: ComfyUI node graph lesson
text: Treat media and AI generation workflows as explicit node graphs with typed inputs, outputs, parameters, model assets, and reproducible metadata attached to generated outputs.

title: Partial re-execution lesson
text: Track node dependencies and content hashes so only changed parts of a workflow rerun, reducing cost for media generation, search, embedding, and eval pipelines.

title: Custom node governance lesson
text: Custom node ecosystems need package trust, ratings, sandboxing, security scanning, version constraints, license metadata, and eval evidence before nodes can be recommended for production pipelines.

title: Low-code workflow import lesson
text: Support importers for Flowise, Dify, Langflow, n8n, ComfyUI, and other workflow formats so existing user workflows can become searchable, rated, and deployable primitives.

title: Multiple representations lesson
text: Represent each pipeline as visual graph, YAML or JSON manifest, runtime plan, eval plan, cost plan, and provenance graph so users can inspect, version, deploy, and benchmark it.

title: Media provenance lesson
text: For generated images, video, audio, and music, store workflow graph, prompt, seed, model versions, source assets, licenses, thumbnails, transcripts, safety report, and content hashes.
